visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and bangs, wearing a grey sheer shirt, holds a white laptop in front of her. She smiles and moves the laptop up and down in a brightly lit indoor hallway with a white wall and a brown door. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the laptop being opened, revealing a grey metallic surface. She points to 'AMD Ryzen AI 7' and 'NVIDIA GeForce' stickers near the keyboard. (3) The woman is now sitting on a green sofa wearing glasses and a black tank top, using the laptop. A black and white cat sits next to her. The keyboard glows with blue backlighting as she interacts with it. (4) Close-up shots focus on the screen showing the 'GIMATE' AI software and its image generation features. A hand is seen pressing the power button and navigating the interface. (5) The woman returns to the frame, hugging the laptop and smiling warmly towards the camera. The background shows a white wall with a framed poster. (6) Multiple quick cuts show a black cat looking at the laptop and the woman petting it while she continues to demonstrate the device.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天要來介紹這台親民又多功能的筆電技嘉GIGABYTEAEROX16. [Logo]: GIGABYTE. (2) [Subtitle]: CPU是採用AMD Ryzen™ AI 7 350 顯卡搭載的是RTX 5070. (3) [Subtitle]: 我使用筆電大部分是在處理一些文書工作偶爾放鬆呢還是會想玩點小遊戲AERO X16就可以同時滿足文書處理跟偶爾遊戲的需求規格對我來說已經非常實用囉. (4) [Subtitle]: 筆電的外形乾淨又簡約非常的好看而且重點是輕薄便攜. [Variety]: 16.75 mm 超輕薄機身 76Wh 大容量電池. (5) [Subtitle]: 接下來是超窄四邊框設計有92%的螢幕佔比工作起來非常舒適喔. (6) [Subtitle]: 最重要的是這台還有內建GIMATE AI 助理能夠透過簡單的指令自動替你更換使用的情境讓電腦的效能可以獲得最佳狀態. (7) [Subtitle]: 最後是應該是有些人會非常喜歡的GIMATE Creator文字生圖功能他沒有生成的次數和費用的問題可以做一些簡單的長輩圖傳到家人群組喔看我弄了一朵蓮花嘿嘿. [Variety]: 早安您好 平安喜樂. (8) [Subtitle]: 整體而言呢GIGABYTE AERO X16是一台高CP值而且相對適合入門的筆電如果有興趣的朋友真的大力推薦歡迎參考看看唷.
